column1: # Hebrew (he) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @id                  a command id (e.g. file.saveAs): wins over the English text for
#                                 that menu item, so one id can read differently from its twin
#            @plural              `source` is "one|other" (English forms); the translation lists the
#                                 language's forms separated by "|" (see `plural` in i18n/mod.rs)
#            anything else        a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Modern Hebrew, written right to left; menu commands use verbal nouns (פתיחה, שמירה בשם…) and
# confirmation questions use the infinitive (למחוק את השכבה?). One term per concept across the UI:
# שכבה (layer), מסכה (mask), בחירה (selection), ערוץ (channel), מברשת (brush), מעבר צבע (gradient),
# דוגמה (pattern), נתיב (path), קו מנחה (guide), משטח עבודה (artboard), משטח ציור (canvas),
# אובייקט חכם (smart object), הגדרה מוכנה (preset), אטימות (opacity). Product and technology names
# (PhotoCraft, ArtCraft, GPU, CMYK, OpenType …) and key names stay in Latin letters; the trailing
# "…" of dialog commands is kept. Western digits. Plural rule: one|other (a count from 2 up takes
# the plural noun). Clean-room: written from the plain meaning of the English labels; no
# proprietary localisation resource was consulted. Drafted with Claude (Anthropic) as an AI
# contributor; native-speaker review of the specialist terms is welcome.
# Layer Mask Display Options (the layer mask rubylith's colour and opacity)
# Channel Options and New Spot Channel (#3761)

column2: Set GPU Memory in Preferences › Performance to what your graphics card can hold, at most 3/8 of its memory. Automatic follows Memory Usage, within a quarter of this computer's memory and 3/8 of the card's, and doesn't count the document against a card whose memory is known. The status bar shows GPU Memory Full while they don't fit.
column3: הגדר את 'זיכרון GPU' ב'העדפות › ביצועים' לכמות שהכרטיס הגרפי שלך יכול להכיל, לכל היותר 3/8 מהזיכרון שלו. 'אוטומטי' עוקב אחר 'שימוש בזיכרון', בתוך רבע מהזיכרון של המחשב הזה ו-3/8 מזה של הכרטיס, ואינו סופר את המסמך כנגד כרטיס שהזיכרון שלו ידוע. שורת המצב מציגה 'זיכרון ה-GPU מלא' כל עוד הן לא נכנסות.
